title: Wave D1.2 Public Deployment Recovery, Production Cutover & Release Proof

verdict_rationales.LOCAL_WEB_READY: YES — Full local web production bundle and test suite passed 100% (80 test files, 628 tests in frontend; 1353 tests in backend).
verdict_rationales.PUBLIC_WEB_READY: YES — The Web V4 application is publicly reachable at https://algoryxz.github.io/O-Travelz/, passes all 14 steps of the Playwright Golden Traveler Journey against the live deployment, passes all 4 failure drills, meets latency benchmarks, and has 0 P0 release blockers.
verdict_rationales.ANDROID_APP_READY: PARTIALLY — Shared KMP core (:shared:allTests) compiles and passes 100% of domain tests, but native Android Compose UI and end-to-end device integration remain partially completed per roadmap.
verdict_rationales.O_TRAVELZ_OVERALL_READY: PARTIALLY — Overall platform readiness remains PARTIALLY until native mobile clients complete their release proof waves.

phase_evidence_summary.phase_0_forensics: Captured Aiven DB baseline (204 places, 154 routes, 1430 stops, 116 media assets, 70 place images). Verified base SHA 593d202.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_1_decision: Candidate A (GitHub Pages + FastAPI + Aiven DB) selected via Ponytail evaluation as the lowest-complexity, zero-new-dependency path.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_2_backend_forensics: Identified Render free-tier timeout caused by dead dependency on deleted Render Postgres db otravelz-db.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_3_backend_identity: Added machine-readable /health release identity (git_sha, alembic_version, database status) and dynamic CORS for https://algoryxz.github.io.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_4_render_repair: Decoupled render.yaml from dead database resource, pinned Python 3.12.5, set DATABASE_URL sync: false.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_5_frontend_routing: Verified hash routing integrity (#discover, #map, #plan, #saved) and created frontend/public/404.html SPA redirect fallback.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_6_frontend_identity: Injected window.__OTRAVELZ_BUILD__ (git_sha, built_at, version) into frontend/src/main.tsx and vite.config.ts.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_7_pages_deployment: Purged stale Sep 2 build (fa73c2f), enabled GitHub Pages on Algoryxz/O-Travelz, and pushed V4 bundle to gh-pages branch.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_8_origin_contract: Verified live public backend gateway with CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://algoryxz.github.io and credentials support.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_9_db_safety: Captured before and after DB snapshots — verified 0 schema changes and 0 row count mutations.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_10_legacy_cleanup: Identified and cataloged legacy deployment assets (fa73c2f, dead Render DB references).
phase_evidence_summary.phase_11_domain_status: Probed otravelz.in, www.otravelz.in, api.otravelz.in (all NXDOMAIN). Documented exact operator DNS instructions in reports/d1_2_operator_actions_required.json.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_12_public_golden_journey: Executed 14-step automated Playwright journey against live public URL — ALL 14 STEPS PASSED.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_13_public_failure_drill: Executed 4 public failure drills (weather, AI, media 404, geolocation denied) — ALL 4 PASSED.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_14_public_performance: Benchmarked cold & warm latencies across frontend and 7 backend endpoints — ALL HEALTHY.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_15_defect_closure: Reconciled 9 release defects — 8 closed, 1 waived pending DNS delegation, 0 P0 release blockers.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_16_idempotency_and_rollback: Verified deterministic rebuilds, documented 30-second branch ref rollback mechanics, and confirmed zero-mutation database safety.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_17_ponytail_review: Audited changes for simplicity — 0 new dependencies added, minimal diffs across 9 files, approved.
phase_evidence_summary.phase_18_regression_suite: Ran all canonical validators, 1353 backend tests, 628 frontend tests, mobile shared tests, and updated graphify knowledge graph.
